situations.title: 어려운 기도 예측 사정
situations.tagline: Let's assess this patient for any difficult airway signs before induction.
situations.brief: 유도 전 어려운 기도 예측 사정을 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me review the airway history and exam.
Are there any predictors of a difficult airway here?
I'll note the neck mobility and mouth opening.

situations.title: Mallampati 평가
situations.tagline: Can you open wide and stick out your tongue for me?
situations.brief: Mallampati 지표로 환자의 기도를 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Open your mouth as wide as you can, please.
Stick your tongue out for me.
This helps us plan for your airway safely.

situations.title: 어려운 기도 카트 준비
situations.tagline: Get the difficult airway cart into the room, just in case.
situations.brief: 어려운 기도에 대비해 기도 카트를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm bringing the difficult airway cart to the bedside.
Let me confirm all the tools are stocked.
The cart is ready if we need it.

situations.title: 비디오후두경 준비
situations.tagline: Have the video laryngoscope ready and turned on.
situations.brief: 비디오후두경(video laryngoscope)을 준비하고 작동을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The video laryngoscope is on and the screen is clear.
I've got the right blade size ready.
It's positioned within reach for you.

situations.title: 보조자 대기
situations.tagline: Do we have someone ready to assist with the airway?
situations.brief: 어려운 기도에 대비해 보조자가 대기하도록 하세요.
keyPhrases: I've got a second person ready to assist.
Let me know if you need help with cricoid or the bougie.
Extra hands are standing by.

situations.title: 산소화 유지 보조
situations.tagline: Let's keep him well pre-oxygenated before we start.
situations.brief: 유도 전후 산소화를 유지하도록 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm holding the mask seal for pre-oxygenation.
Let's maximize his oxygen reserve first.
Saturation is good before we proceed.

situations.title: 예측 어려운 기도 계획
situations.tagline: This looks like a difficult airway — what's our plan A, B, and C?
situations.brief: 예측된 어려운 기도에 대해 단계별 계획을 수립하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's define plan A, B, and C before induction.
If direct fails, we move to the video scope, then the LMA.
Everyone should know the backup steps.
goals: 팀 전원이 백업 단계를 공유하게 한다

situations.title: 각성 삽관 보조
situations.tagline: We're doing an awake intubation — help keep him calm and topicalized.
situations.brief: 각성 삽관(awake intubation)을 보조하며 환자를 안정시키세요.
keyPhrases: I'll help keep the airway topicalized.
Let me reassure the patient through each step.
Tell me when you need suction or the scope.

situations.title: 후두마스크 구조 환기
situations.tagline: Mask ventilation is failing — let's place an LMA to rescue.
situations.brief: 환기 실패 시 후두마스크(LMA)로 구조 환기를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Hand me the LMA — we're rescuing the airway.
Let's get ventilation established quickly.
I'll confirm chest rise once it's in.

situations.title: 부지·교환기 사용
situations.tagline: Pass me the bougie — I can feel the tracheal rings with it.
situations.brief: 부지(bougie)나 교환기를 사용해 삽관을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Here's the bougie — railroad the tube over it.
I've got the tube exchanger ready.
Tell me if you feel the tracheal clicks.

situations.title: 목·비만 위험 인자
situations.tagline: His short neck and high BMI put him at risk — let's account for that.
situations.brief: 짧은 목과 비만 등 어려운 기도 위험 인자를 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: The short neck and obesity increase our difficulty.
Let's position with ramping to improve the view.
I'm flagging these risk factors to the team.

situations.title: 재시도 최소화 전략
situations.tagline: Let's limit attempts — too many tries will make this worse.
situations.brief: 삽관 시도를 제한해 기도 손상을 최소화하세요.
keyPhrases: We limit ourselves to a set number of attempts.
After that, we move to the next plan.
Repeated tries only cause trauma and edema.

situations.title: 산소화 우선 원칙
situations.tagline: Forget the tube for a second — let's oxygenate him first.
situations.brief: 삽관보다 산소화(oxygenation)를 우선하는 원칙을 지키세요.
keyPhrases: Oxygenation comes before intubation — let's bag him.
Let's get his saturation up before another attempt.
The priority is oxygen, not the tube.

situations.title: 팀 역할 배정
situations.tagline: Let's assign roles now — who's on cricoid, who's on the cart?
situations.brief: 어려운 기도 상황에 대비해 팀 역할을 배정하세요.
keyPhrases: You take cricoid pressure, I'll manage the cart.
Let's each know our role before we start.
Call out clearly when you need the next tool.

situations.title: 백업 장비 준비
situations.tagline: If plan A fails, is all the backup equipment out and ready?
situations.brief: 삽관 실패에 대비한 백업 장비를 미리 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: The LMA, bougie, and cric kit are all out and ready.
Let me lay out the backup tools in order.
Everything's within reach if plan A fails.

situations.title: CICO 상황
situations.tagline: We can't intubate and we can't oxygenate — this is a CICO emergency.
situations.brief: 삽관과 산소화가 모두 불가한 CICO 상황을 인지하고 긴급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a can't-intubate-can't-oxygenate situation.
We move to emergency front-of-neck access now.
Get the cric kit open — call for help.

situations.title: 응급 윤상갑상막절개
situations.tagline: We're going for a cricothyrotomy — get the kit and help me now.
situations.brief: 응급 윤상갑상막절개(cricothyrotomy)를 보조하며 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Cric kit is open — I'm handing you the scalpel.
I'll stabilize the larynx for you.
Tell me the moment you're through the membrane.

situations.title: 저산소 서맥 진행
situations.tagline: Saturation's in the sixties and the heart rate's crashing — we're losing him.
situations.brief: 저산소로 서맥이 진행되는 위기를 인지하고 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Sats are critically low and he's bradycardic.
We need to oxygenate immediately or he'll arrest.
Push the airway rescue and prep for code.

situations.title: 예상외 어려운 기도
situations.tagline: This was supposed to be routine, but I can't get a view — it's unanticipated.
situations.brief: 예상외로 어려운 기도가 발생하면 신속히 계획을 전환하세요.
keyPhrases: This is an unanticipated difficult airway.
Let's switch to the failed airway algorithm now.
Get the difficult airway cart in immediately.

situations.title: 기도 완전 폐쇄
situations.tagline: There's no airflow at all — the airway is completely obstructed.
situations.brief: 기도 완전 폐쇄가 발생하면 긴급 개통 조치에 나서세요.
keyPhrases: Total airway obstruction — no air is moving.
We go straight to front-of-neck access.
Call the surgeon in for an emergency airway now.

situations.title: 위기 후 기도 계획 문서화
situations.tagline: Now that he's stable, let's document exactly what happened with the airway.
situations.brief: 기도 위기 후 대응 과정과 향후 계획을 문서화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's document what worked and what failed.
This goes in the record as a difficult airway alert.
Future teams need to know his airway history.
